text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. When building an app, one important choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are made for one platform, like iOS or Android, while cross-platform apps work on both. Another key point is responsive design, which makes sure the app looks good on different screen sizes. After development, you usually publish your app on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. However, performance matters a lot. Users expect apps to load quickly and run smoothly. If an app is slow or crashes, people will delete it. So developers must test carefully before releasing their work.
